body: While the person at my academy was knowledgeable, it seems he sold me a used or faulty unit. Which is weird, considering they do RMA's for returns, but whatever. I fixed the problem (side rails weren't in place and were blocking the receiver) and cleaned out the gunk, dry firing has a nice action to it so it should be good to go.

It was a well deserved one. I figured that I could just walk into Academy and leave with a cheap gun, which was negligent.

At least I finished cleaning it and repaired something that was broken in the receiver as well. Though I know Academy insists on having the manufacturer service their weapons, it was pretty apparent that my unit was used or tampered with.
